frame.platformStrip: Platform admin. You’re outside every organisation: what you change here applies across the platform. To see an organisation from the inside, use Log in as on one of its people.

organizations.switch: {name}: switch organisation or open its settings
organizations.inviteLinkInvalid: Paste the whole invite link you were sent.
organizations.leaveDescription: You lose access to its courses, groups, feedback and improvements, and your sync tokens and Claude connections for it stop. An owner or admin can invite you again.

errors.impersonating: You are logged in as someone else. Return to your own account first.
errors.notMember: You are not in this organisation.
errors.onlyOwner: You are its only owner. Make someone else owner, or delete the organisation.

session.idleText: For your security, you’ll be signed out at {time}.
session.maxText: Your session ends at {time}. Save your work, then sign in again.

discard.title: Discard your changes?
discard.text: What you changed here isn’t saved yet.

invite.justLink: Just the link: I’ll send it

feedback.replyShownLearner: Your reply · shown to this learner
feedback.learnerPlaceholder: They see it next to this passage, in their lesson.
feedback.deleteText: It's deleted for good, and stops counting on Insights. This can't be undone.
feedback.replyMarksDone: Sending marks it done. To change the lesson for it, use it instead.

needsYou.groupFeedback: {count, plural, one {# new piece} other {# new pieces}} of feedback in {group}
needsYou.suggested: {count, plural, one {# change} other {# changes}} suggested by groups for {course}
needsYou.drafts: {count, plural, one {# draft} other {# drafts}} to review
needsYou.groupImprovements: {count, plural, one {# improvement is yours} other {# improvements are yours}} in {group}
needsYou.courseImprovements: {count, plural, one {# improvement is yours} other {# improvements are yours}} on {course}’s own lessons
needsYou.groupUnpublished: {count, plural, one {# lesson has changes} other {# lessons have changes}} learners don’t see yet in {group}
needsYou.courseUnpublished: {count, plural, one {# lesson has changes} other {# lessons have changes}} learners don’t see yet on {course}’s own lessons

home.title: Home
home.welcome: Welcome. Let’s design your first course.
home.description: What needs you, your groups and your courses. Learners’ feedback shapes each group’s lessons; you approve every change.
home.joinedFull: Your groups and courses are in the sidebar.
home.joinedGuest: You’re a guest instructor: open your group below and mark what happens in class.
home.joinedLimited: You work on the courses and groups an owner or admin chose for you.
home.nothingWaits: Nothing waits on you right now. New feedback and drafts to review show here.
home.noAccess: You don't have any courses or groups here yet. Ask an owner or admin to give you access.

ai.keyInvalid: Anthropic refused your organisation’s API key. An owner or admin can replace it in Settings → AI.
ai.cap: This month’s included AI is used up. An owner or admin can top up in Settings → AI.
ai.paused: AI is off while your organisation is paused; it’s back when an owner or admin resumes the plan.
ai.plan: On your plan, AI works in your own Claude: open any AI request there (“Use with Claude”).
ai.mock: AI is in sample mode (AI_MOCK=1): drafts are canned examples. Add an Anthropic API key and remove AI_MOCK to use Claude.
ai.offUntilKey: AI in the app is off until an owner or admin adds an Anthropic API key in Settings → AI.
ai.offInstallation: AI drafting is off on this installation. Set ANTHROPIC_API_KEY (or AI_MOCK=1 to try it with sample output) to turn it on.
ai.connector: Meanwhile, every AI request can be opened in your own Claude (“Use with Claude”).

impersonation.refused: You’re logged in as this user: their sign-in details and keys are theirs to change.

gettingStarted.title: Getting started
gettingStarted.note: A few steps, then you’re teaching.
gettingStarted.allDone: All set. Class is in session!

how.title: Two minutes on how it works
how.hint: The loop every group goes through, and where AI helps.

profile.title: Complete your profile
profile.hint: Your name and a photo, so learners know who wrote what.

course.title: Create your first course
course.hint: Its title and a line on who it’s for.

invite.title: Invite a colleague
invite.hint: To design the course with you.

obsidian.title: Connect your vault
obsidian.hint: Install the Chalkenso plugin and your lessons sync both ways.

howItWorks.title: How Chalkenso works
howItWorks.description: The loop every group goes through, where AI helps on your plan, and who decides.

teach.title: Teach
teach.text: Learners open their link; you note in class on the passage.

feedback.title: Feedback
feedback.text: Each lesson collects where people got stuck.

improve.title: Improve
improve.text: Fix a lesson from its feedback, with AI’s help.

publish.title: Publish
publish.text: The next group reads the better version.

decide.title: You decide
decide.text: Every draft waits in the lesson’s Improve view, whoever made it. Tick the changes to keep, then save and publish. Nothing reaches learners before that.

howItWorks.membersNote: Your organisation’s owners and admins set up AI, the team and the plan.

app.title: AI in the app
app.text: Revise lessons and draft plans with your organisation’s Anthropic key, set in Settings → AI.

vault.title: Claude Code in Obsidian
vault.text: The Chalkenso plugin syncs lessons with your vault, and Claude Code works on them there.
